summary: The direct Global HSL mask cache can keep old coverage after an upstream Whites edit.
evidence: The key drops FILM_RESPONSE_ENABLED..GRAIN_SEED_LOW, which also contains WHITES, TONE_LIMITER, TONE_KNEE, TONE_GREY and TONE_PEAK. toneZonesWgsl reads these before applyHsl. With an unchanged source and HSL recipe, encodeHslSelection therefore reuses old coverage if only omitted slots change. Local GPU hue leaves use the same identity.
proposed_fix: Replace exclusion ranges with explicit upstream dependencies shared by Global HSL and Local hue selection. Do not change selection math.
check: Prime a non-neutral HSL recipe, move only Whites on the same direct source, and compare the settled picture with a forced cold selection at the identical final grade. Repeat with a Local hue mask.
notes: Patch intentionally not written in Phase 2.

summary: The picker synchronizes the same global edit state twice before sending one post-release sampling request.
evidence: hslPickSamples awaits syncGlobalEditState then calls hslFetchStage, which awaits syncGlobalEditState and editCommandQueue again. Pointer moves only collect coordinates, so there is no GPU readback or backend request per pointer move.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; likely below the 15 ms audit floor when clean. Retaining one save fence is more important than eliminating this small duplicate.
proposed_fix: Keep one guarded save and revision fence in hslFetchStage; trace whether it saves any actual work first.
check: Add a picker release-to-colour-selected probe alongside the HSL own-control step; use hsl-picker-speed.js for coverage.

summary: Tiled HSL rebuilds selection from scratch for every tile even during HSL slider edits that do not change coverage.
evidence: Main and Clarity tile calls pass no prepareKey, unlike the direct route. Each tile encodes the fields pass, four preparation dispatches and three selection dispatches for a one-layer recipe without edge shaping; output storage is overwritten by the next tile.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; highest potential on warm HSL saturation drags forced to tiled rendering. A material gain is plausible if the selection passes dominate, but persistent mask storage could be worse on the Neo.
proposed_fix: Measure the direct and tiled routes separately, then assess bounded visible-tile mask reuse keyed by source generation, upstream grade, region and mask settings. Do not retain full-frame scratch.
check: HSL own Saturation drag at Fit on both photos; add large/100% or forced tiled only if Fit does not exercise it. Compare first feedback, settle and peak memory.

summary: Show selection repeats CPU guide preparation and PNG transfer after range changes and even after edits that leave coverage unchanged.
evidence: renderHslPanels keys refresh on editRevision/globalEditGeneration, and hslEnd submits a detailed request even when only hue, saturation or luminance changed. hslDrainSelection serializes requests, so release can wait behind one obsolete draft. sample_stage caches only upstream RGB, then redoes selection preparation, selection, PNG/base64 and browser decode.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; removing a needless refresh eliminates the whole overlay wait and contention for that edit. For actual range changes the saving is the prepare share plus any obsolete draft still in flight.
proposed_fix: Key refreshes on visible selection inputs, not every grade revision. Reuse prepared data only for the same stage identity, region and scale within the existing memory allowance.
check: Extra HSL own-control probe with Show selection enabled: change Saturation, wheels and Vignette (no request expected); then Range/Feather and Exposure (refresh expected). Compare release-to-exact overlay and the prepare/select/encode breakdown.

summary: Global HSL picking and Show selection sample the un-denoised picture even when the rendered HSL selects the denoised one.
evidence: sample_stage uses cache.hsl_stage_input, which calls capture_stage_input from raw proxies without a source_filter; the direct GPU fields pass binds sourceProxy after Denoise resolution and tiled HSL uses the denoised tile. The sample request carries adjustments but no Denoise selection state. In noisy or heavily cleaned regions the selected hue and mask can differ.
proposed_fix: Resolve which Denoise source/approximation the picker should represent and share that identity with the selection endpoint; no additional GPU readback on the drag path without evidence.
check: Compare Show selection and a strong HSL luminance grade on the same noisy crop with Denoise off/on; verify the picker tracks what the grade actually selects.
notes: Patch intentionally not written in Phase 2.

summary: Turning HSL off does not release its large, grow-only GPU work textures.
evidence: Per-canvas direct and tiled engines retain capacity up to their largest width, height and layer count; disabling HSL returns before ensure and leaves allocations alive. releaseHslSelection is on transient-resource teardown. A one-layer engine holds 80 bytes per work pixel plus coarse data (about 320 MB at 4 megapixels), and each additional layer adds 16 bytes per pixel.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; mostly a memory-headroom benefit, potentially avoiding slower routes under pressure. No expected speedup for a warm HSL-on frame by itself.
proposed_fix: Measure residency and route changes first; release inactive scratch under pressure or after an idle delay, keeping resources alive until fenced.
check: HSL own eye on/off and warm Denoise toggle at large/Fit; inspect idle GPU bytes and route before ON, after OFF and after re-enable. The interleaved OFF timings are not a cold-memory baseline.

summary: A nonzero Black & White mix adds 25 neighbouring texture reads per pixel before the normal grade, even when only Exposure or Contrast is being dragged.
evidence: The guided path samples a clamped 5×5 source lattice, then runs the upstream colour/tone prefix for the pixel and its guide. HSL fields repeats it in its own pass when stacked. With B&W neutral or off, the guide is skipped. Denoise changes the source the guide reads.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; a warm guide reuse could remove most of the incremental B&W cost on Exposure/Contrast or Reds drags if texture loads dominate; a Denoise source swap is a legitimate miss.
proposed_fix: Compare the existing fused path with source-keyed guide reuse only if material. Preserve the same tap ordering and do not grow the memory budget; measure before any separate pass.
check: B&W Exposure/Contrast ON vs OFF, Reds own drag, and Denoise toggle on/off. Separate warm render cost from first guide computation and check settled pixel parity.
